kp_title: Constructing General Solutions of First-Order Linear Systems of ODEs
raw_html:
3.Constructing General Solutions of First-Order Linear Systems of ODEs?

Let x1(t) and x2(t) satisfy the homogeneous system x′(t)=A x(t) and xp(t) satisfy the inhomogeneous system x′(t)=A x(t)+f(t). Which of the following is always a solution of the same inhomogeneous system?

  1. 2⋅x1(t)+x2(t)+xp(t)
  2. −5⋅x1(t)−xp(t)
  3. 3⋅x1(t)−2⋅x2(t)+3⋅xp(t)
E
